answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: bond every trust edge, burn both ends if it is collusive. To form a vouching or grading link, both parties lock collateral into that edge; a later audit ruling the pair kin burns both bonds. A fleet needs a dense web of edges to look legitimate, but each now costs locked capital from two sides with joint liability, so wiring a thousand fakes is a thousand edges at risk. Honest agents form few real links and reach the nectar on the horizon of earned trust. A fake lattice is a lotus with no roots: every connection it must fake is a paid, slashable bet it loses.
